note: Written for 0.4.4 and committed before any hook change for 0.4.4. None of the prompts was run through any hook before this commit. L prompts are quick look-ups on one named file (some handed to an agent); S prompts are real work that starts with the same verbs (check, show, find, list); K prompts are controls. Do not edit a task after a run uses it.

substantive.prompt: Check app.py for SQL injection and fix every instance you find.
Check whether landing.html meets WCAG contrast and heading rules, and list each fix it needs.
Check the error handling in app.py and add tests for the cases it misses.
Find every place app.py trusts user input and explain the risk of each one.
Show the size of each function in app.py and suggest which ones to split up and how.
Check whether outage-notes.txt supports the root cause stated in CHANGELOG.md, and write a short memo on what doesn't match.
Have a background agent check app.py for race conditions and propose fixes.
List every hardcoded secret in app.py and rewrite the code to read them from environment variables.

non_substantive.prompt: Check if para.txt ends with a newline.
Show me the last line of outage-notes.txt.
Get the file size of landing.html.
Show the third line of para.txt.
Find the line number where parse_amount is defined in app.py.
Have a subagent check whether app.py uses f-strings.
What is the boiling point of water in Celsius?
Run the code-review skill on app.py.
